biography_english:
A Walister who served in the Order of {order}. She was raised at an abbey on the outskirts of Almorica, eventually becoming a sibyl of Philaha. Her parents also served the order, but were slain by the Galgastani while en route to provide aid to those suffering in Krysaro. Hearing of Duke Ronwey's liberation, she defied the opposition of her superiors and joined the Walister Resistance.
  She joined the Order of {order} after {hero} went to her aid at Krysaro, but was later dismissed.
biography_spanish:
Una walister que sirvio en la Orden de {order}. Crecio en una abadia cerca de Almorica y con el tiempo fue sibila de Philaha. Sus padres servian a la orden, pero los galgastanies los mataron al ir a ayudar a los sufrientes de Krysaro. Al saber de la liberacion del duque Ronwey, desoyo a sus superiores y se unio a la Resistencia walister.
  Se unio a la Orden de {order} tras recibir la ayuda de {hero} en Krysaro, pero despues fue expulsada.

biography_english:
The former head of the Didarro family, and father to Hektor Didarro, who defends Brigantys Castle.
  House Didarro's lineage traces back to Count Orlandeau, a Coritanae noble of note. They also share a bloodline with the Lord of Coritanae, current King of Galgastan, and have won the respect of many fellow citizens.
biography_spanish:
Antiguo patriarca de los Didarro y padre de Hektor, quien defiende el castillo de Brigantys.
  Su linaje se remonta al conde Orlandeau, insigne noble coritanio. Comparten sangre con el lider de Coritana, hoy rey de Galgastan, y tienen el respeto de muchos compatriotas.

biography_english:
The former head of the Didarro family, and father to Hektor Didarro, who defends Brigantys Castle. House Didarro's lineage traces back to Coritanae noble Count Orlandeau, and they also share a bloodline with the Lord of Coritanae.
  Briam was pained by what his homeland had become under Hierophant Balbatos. Hearing that the Walister Resistance were on the march, he freed the enemies of Balbatos imprisoned at Brigantys Castle.
biography_spanish:
Antiguo patriarca de los Didarro y padre de Hektor, quien defiende el castillo de Brigantys. Su linaje se remonta al conde Orlandeau, noble coritanio, y comparten sangre con el lider de Coritana.
  A Briam le dolia ver en que se habia convertido su tierra con el jerarca Balbatos. Al saber del avance de la Resistencia walister, libero a los enemigos del jerarca presos en Brigantys.

biography_english:
A Galgastani who formerly headed the Didarro family. House Didarro's lineage traces back to Coritanae noble Count Orlandeau, and they also share a bloodline with the Lord of Coritanae.
  Briam was pained by what his homeland had become under Hierophant Balbatos. Hearing that the Walister Resistance was on the march, he freed the enemies of Balbatos imprisoned in Brigantys Castle. Remaining loyal to the crown to the end, he took his own life for failing to prevent the fall of Brigantys.
biography_spanish:
Galgastani que fue patriarca de los Didarro. Su linaje se remonta al conde Orlandeau, noble coritanio, y comparten sangre con el lider de Coritana.
  A Briam le dolia en que se habia convertido su patria tras el jerarca Balbatos. Al saber del avance de la Resistencia walister, libero a los presos de Brigantys. Leal a la corona hasta el final, se quito la vida al no evitar la caida de Brigantys.

biography_english: A young girl living in Heim. She was orphaned when the Bakram invaded Rhime. Having overcome the grief of her loss, she now spends her days caring for refugees at an abbey in Heim.
biography_spanish: Una joven de Heim, huerfana tras la invasion bakramiana de Rhime. Superada la pena de su perdida, hoy cuida a los refugiados en una abadia de Heim.

biography_english:
A young Bakram girl living in Heim.
  She was orphaned when the Bakram invaded Rhime. She came close to death at the hands of the Dark Knights herself, but was rescued by the Holy Knight Lanselot.
  Having overcome the grief of her loss, she now spends her days caring for refugees at an abbey in Heim.
biography_spanish:
Una joven bakramiana de Heim.
  Quedo huerfana tras la invasion de Rhime. Casi muere a manos de los Caballeros Oscuros, pero la salvo el Caballero Sagrado Lanselot.
  Superada la pena de su perdida, hoy cuida a los refugiados en una abadia de Heim.

biography_english:
High champion of the Dark Knights Loslorien. He was sent to Valeria when a secret treaty was forged between the Holy Lodissian Empire and the Bakram leader Brantyn.
  The Dark Knights report directly to High Priest Sardian, and Lanselot is thought to be his top lieutenant.
biography_spanish:
Alto campeon de Loslorien. Fue enviado a Valeria tras el pacto secreto entre Lodis y el lider bakramiano Brantyn.
  Los Caballeros Oscuros responden ante el sumo sacerdote Sardian, y se cree que Lanselot es su mano derecha.

biography_english:
High champion of the Dark Knights Loslorien.
  He was sent to Valeria when a secret treaty was forged between the Holy Lodissian Empire and the Bakram leader Brantyn. However, his true task was to occupy Valeria and seek the wondrous powers thought hidden there.
  He attempted to use the sword Brynhildr stolen from the Kingdom of New Xenobia to unravel the mystery of these powers. However, finally realizing they were beyond man's control, he considered withdrawing from Valeria.
  He was detained when Sir Martym and Sir Barbas rebelled against him, but later escaped during a battle between Resistance and Bakram forces. His current whereabouts are not known.
biography_spanish:
Alto campeon de los Caballeros Oscuros de Loslorien.
  Fue enviado a Valeria tras el pacto secreto entre Lodis y el lider bakramiano Brantyn. Mas su fin real era ocupar Valeria y buscar los grandes poderes que oculta.
  Intento usar la espada Brunilda, robada al Reino de Nueva Xenobia, para desvelar tales poderes. Mas al notar que escapaban al control humano, penso en retirarse de Valeria.
  Fue apresado tras la rebelion de sir Martym y sir Barbas, pero escapo en la batalla entre la Resistencia y los bakramianos. Hoy se desconoce su paradero.

biography_english: Second-in-command of the Dark Knights Loslorien, hailing from Galius, seat of the Holy Lodissian Empire. He is the son of Stratarchis Vogras, who commanded five of the orders of knighthood in Lodis. Loslorien enjoys independence from the Senate thanks to the influence of Vogras.
biography_spanish: Segundo de los Caballeros Oscuros de Loslorien, de Galius, sede del Imperio de Lodis. Hijo del estratarca Vogras, quien mando cinco ordenes de caballer▼a en Lodis. Loslorien goza de independencia del Senado gracias a la influencia de Vogras.

biography_english:
Second-in-command of the Dark Knights Loslorien, hailing from Galius, seat of the Holy Lodissian Empire. He is the son of Stratarchis Vogras, who commanded five of the orders of knighthood in Lodis. House Rahms is also known for producing some of the Holy Empire's greatest warriors. Balxephon carries significant weight among the Dark Knights, and also has the full confidence of Lanselot Tartaros.
  He and Sir Oz were routed by the Resistance at Phidoch Castle.
biography_spanish:
Segundo de los Caballeros Oscuros de Loslorien, de Galius, sede de Lodis. Hijo del estratarca Vogras, quien mando cinco ordenes de caballeria en Lodis. La casa Rahms destaca por dar grandes guerreros al Imperio. Balxephon tiene peso en la orden y la plena confianza de Lanselot Tartaros.
  El y sir Oz cayeron ante la Resistencia en Phidoch.

biography_english:
Second-in-command of the Dark Knights Loslorien, hailing from Galius, seat of the Holy Lodissian Empire. He is the son of Stratarchis Vogras, who commanded five of the orders of knighthood in Lodis. House Rahms is also known for producing some of the Holy Empire's greatest warriors. Balxephon carries significant weight among the Dark Knights, and also has the full confidence of Lanselot Tartaros.
  He was betrayed by Sir Martym and Sir Barbas at Heim Castle. Though detained for a time, he escaped during a battle between Resistance and Bakram forces. He has not been seen since.
biography_spanish:
Segundo de los Caballeros Oscuros de Loslorien, natural de Galius, sede de Lodis. Hijo del estratarca Vogras, quien mando cinco ordenes de caballeria en Lodis. La casa Rahms destaca por dar grandes guerreros al Imperio. Balxephon tiene mucho peso en la orden y la plena confianza de Lanselot Tartaros.
  Fue traicionado por sir Martym y sir Barbas en el castillo de Heim. Tras estar preso un tiempo, logro escapar durante la batalla entre la Resistencia y los bakramianos. Nadie ha vuelto a verle desde entonces.

biography_english:
A Loslorien commander.
  Little is known of his past, or how he came to join the Dark Knights. His loyalty to Lodis is unquestionable, and he has earned a great deal of respect from those serving under him.
  A career soldier, he never lets personal matters interfere with his duties.
biography_spanish:
Comandante de Loslorien.
  Poco se sabe de su pasado o de como se unio a los Caballeros Oscuros. Su lealtad a Lodis es intachable y se ha ganado el respeto de sus subordinados.
  Soldado de profesion, jamas deja que los asuntos personales interfieran en sus deberes.

biography_english:
A Loslorien commander.
  Little is known of his past, or how he came to join the Dark Knights. His loyalty to Lodis is unquestionable, and he has earned a great deal of respect from those serving under him.

biography_english:
A Loslorien commander from Galius, seat of the Holy Lodissian Empire.
  He is known for his cunning swordplay. He will stop at nothing to achieve victory, living by the motto, "It always comes to blood." Though his words lack grace, he wields a blade with great finesse.
  He was one of the Dark Knights who attacked Golyat. Together with Sir Barbas he also took part in the sacking of Rhime, where he clashed steel with Sir Gildas.
biography_spanish:
Comandante de Loslorien, de Galius, sede de Lodis.
  Destaca por su astuto manejo de la espada. Haria lo que fuera para vencer, bajo el lema: "Al final todo acaba en sangre". Carece de finura al hablar, pero es diestro con la hoja.
  Fue uno de los Caballeros Oscuros que ataco Golyat. Junto a sir Barbas participo en el saqueo de Rhime, donde lucho contra sir Gildas.

A Loslorien commander from Galius, seat of the Holy Lodissian Empire. He is known for his cunning swordplay. He will stop at nothing to achieve victory, living by the motto, "It always comes to blood." Though his words lack grace, he wields a blade with great finesse.
  He rebelled with Sirs Barbas and Andoras, seduced by the promise of King Dorgalua's legacy. They took possession of Brynhildr and fled to the Hanging Gardens.
biography_spanish:
Comandante de Loslorien, de Galius, sede de Lodis. Destaca por su astuto manejo de la espada. Haria lo que fuera para vencer, bajo el lema: "Al final todo acaba en sangre". Carece de finura al hablar, pero es diestro con la hoja.
  Se rebelo con sir Barbas y sir Andoras, seducido por el legado del rey Dorgalua. Tras hacerse con Brunilda, huyeron a los Jardines Colgantes.

  He rebelled with Sirs Barbas and Andoras, seduced by the promise of King Dorgalua's legacy. They used Brynhildr to open the Chaos Gate, but were slain in a battle with {hero}.
